reason: Both are for-profit postsecondary operators earning tuition from students, and both run nursing and healthcare programs on campuses (APEI's Rasmussen and Hondros, Legacy's California colleges). APEI's largest business is online degrees for military and veterans (AMU/APUS), which Legacy doesn't offer. Legacy is only allied health on six California campuses. The two overlap in one APEI line, so the score is at most 1.
